# Command reference

The **35 contributed commands** for Mysti **2.0.3**, generated from the manifest and English labels. Open VS Code's Command Palette and search the displayed title.

Visibility and enablement conditions are declarations; workspace trust, runtime registration and the active editor still affect availability. Some commands require an editor selection, internal arguments or a development context. A command's presence does not establish native feature acceptance.

These are VS Code commands. Chat slash commands and provider-native commands are different surfaces; see [the feature guide](FEATURES.md#slash-commands) and [agent assignments](MENTIONS.md).
